definitions.name: Retrieve Qdrant Points
definitions.documentation: Retrieve Qdrant Points. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Single response page; scroll returns next_page_offset, which must be supplied explicitly on the next invocation. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. Qdrant and its logo belong to their respective owners; independent integration without endorsement. definitions.name: Scroll Qdrant Points
definitions.documentation: Scroll Qdrant Points. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Single response page; scroll returns next_page_offset, which must be supplied explicitly on the next invocation. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. Qdrant and its logo belong to their respective owners; independent integration without endorsement. definitions.documentation: Batch Query Qdrant Points. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Single response page; scroll returns next_page_offset, which must be supplied explicitly on the next invocation. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. definitions.name: Group Qdrant Query Points
definitions.documentation: Group Qdrant Query Points. One bounded HTTPS REST request; no automatic pagination, retries, embedding/inference, uploads, downloads or remote snapshot recovery. Single response page; scroll returns next_page_offset, which must be supplied explicitly on the next invocation. $retries must be 0 or absent. Explicit HTTPS origin and encrypted QDRANT_API_KEY/apiKeySecret reference, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config.endpoint and credentials.apiKey. Total deadline 100–30000 ms starts before profiles/secrets; request/response <=1 MiB. Lists <=1000; batch queries <=16; dense dimensions <=65536, multivectors <=128, sparse indices unique uint32 with matching values. Filters support one nested object in must clauses and <=32 conditions per clause; other clauses accept leaf conditions. uint64 and int64 fields use exact bounded decimal text and encode as raw JSON integers; order_value and order_by.start_from retain safe numbers/noninteger doubles, while unsafe integer Numbers reject; UUID IDs and safe numeric IDs also supported. Unsafe integer response tokens become decimal text, including variable payloads; unsafe noninteger precision is IEEE-754. Unknown provider fields are projected away. Snapshots require wait=true; no asynchronous completion claim. No deployment or live-provider verification is implied. Qdrant and its logo belong to their respective owners; independent integration without endorsement.
